tools.name: check_log
tools.description: Parse ADI or ADX and validate every supplied field against bundled ADIF 3.1.8 types and tables. Return field problems, duplicate candidates and conflicting values without changing field values. Callsign and DXCC checks are shape and plausibility checks, not a license lookup. Free: 500 QSOs total and

tools.name: repair_log
tools.description: Repair and merge ADI or ADX with deterministic code. Return before and after changes, validation issues, duplicates, conflicts and paged QSOs. Safe repairs trim spaces, derive bands and fix old mode names. Missing end times stay empty unless fillEnd is true, which copies the start time. UTC shifts r

tools.name: explain_qso
tools.description: Read the supplied logs and return one QSO before and after, the exact changes, field errors and duplicate pairs. QSO ids use log:record, starting at 1. No model makes repair decisions in the engine.

tools.name: save_rules
tools.description: Save repair settings for a Pro code. Saves only validated settings, never logs, callsigns, timestamps or duplicate decisions. A returned rule_id belongs to that code. Pass rule_id to update an existing set.

tools.name: pro_status
tools.description: Check a Pro code and show limits and sale status. Pro costs $19 one time. This tool does not buy anything.
